prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 17 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1187; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck by another car. The reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder injury diagnosed, and the force involved would be expected to produce this type of soft tissue damage. Over the course of 17 visits, care included physical therapy, range of motion work, and home exercise instruction. The duration of treatment was somewhat longer than typically seen for a shoulder injury of this kind, and progress was gradual. On examination, several findings support the presence of a shoulder injury, including reduced range of motion and tenderness over the affected area, while other tests, including neurovascular checks and certain stability assessments, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same shoulder has been reported or identified in the patient's history. Billing records for this episode of care are currently under routine review, as two similar charges appearing on the same day are being verified. Ongoing reassessment is planned to monitor function and guide the remaining plan of care.
